programme.desc: Relive another extraordinary Premier League campaign as Liverpool soared to an historic 20th league title, Nottingham Forest defied expectations and the promoted sides were strenuously challenged. There were also tactical transformations, shifts in narrative trends, and a more open field than ever before. Review of the Season documents all of the thrilling stories to emerge across the 380 matches.

programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: We dive into the fiercest rivalry in English football-Manchester United and Liverpool. As Liverpool draw level with United's record haul of top-flight titles, this is a story of history, pride, and the relentless pursuit of greatness. With insight from icons on both sides-Ian Rush, Lou Macari, Brian Kidd, Michael Owen, Phil Thompson, and new Liverpool boss Arne Slot, we unpack the moments that have defined generations, split families, and lit up the Premier League.

programme.title: PL MOMENTS
programme.desc: Steve McManaman revisits ten standout moments from his Premier League career, from his breakthrough at Anfield to unforgettable solo goals and Merseyside derby magic. With flair, humour and personal insight, PL Moments takes you inside the story of one of the Premier League's most creative and entertaining players.

programme.title: PL REWIND
programme.desc: Michael Owen burst onto the scene for Liverpool at just seventeen years of age, and in two consecutive seasons the teenage sensation won the Premier League Golden Boot. Owen recalls those campaigns for the Reds, reliving the key moments that helped him develop into one of the greatest players of his generation.

programme.title: PL REWIND
programme.desc: Blackburn Rovers' Premier League title win in 1994/95 was a historic achievement. Under the guidance of Kenny Dalglish, and fuelled by the prolific partnership of Alan Shearer and Chris Sutton, the small-town club dethroned Manchester United and reached the pinnacle of English football. Captain Tim Sherwood recalls the key moments.

programme.title: PL REWIND

programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: We celebrate the unique legacy of footballing dynasties in the Premier League; where talent, passion, and pride are passed from one generation to the next. From the iconic saves of Peter Schmeichel to the rise of his son Kasper, the goal-scoring legacy of Ian Wright carried on by son's Shaun and Bradley, and the Lampards' deep-rooted Chelsea connection, this episode explores the bonds that tie football families together.

programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: Lauded as one of the greatest footballers of his generation, Ruud Gullit's venture into management brought about mixed fortunes, including a well-publicised fallout with Ex-Newcastle striker Alan Shearer. programme.title: Arsenal vs PSG - UEFA Champions League 2024/25 MD2
programme.desc: Arsenal are unbeaten in their previous four meetings with Paris SG in European competition. Indeed, the French side have played more games against the Gunners without winning than against any other opponent in European competition. Paris SG have lost each of their last three away games against English sides in the UEFA Champions League, losing twice to Manchester City. and once to Newcastle last season. Their 1-4 defeat at St. James’ Park last term was their heaviest away defeat to an English opponent in European competition.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Bologna - UEFA Champions League 2024/25 MD2
programme.desc: Liverpool and Bologna have never previously faced before, while Bologna will be the Reds’ 10th different Italian opponent in European competition, after Internazionale, Juventus, Roma, Genoa, Milan, Fiorentina, Napoli, Udinese, and Atalanta. Bologna have faced three English sides previously in all European competitions, most recently Fulham in the 2002 Intertoto Cup. Their last in a major European competition came against Leeds United in the 1966-67 Inter-Cities Fairs Cup, losing via a coin toss after a 1-1 aggregate draw over two legs.

programme.title: Everton vs Liverpool - English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Everton won 2-0 in their last Premier League game against Liverpool in April 2024, last winning consecutive league Merseyside derbies in the 1984-85 campaign. Liverpool’s 2-0 loss in this exact fixture last season ended a 12-game unbeaten away run in the Premier League against Everton. They’ve not lost consecutive visits to Goodison Park since a run of three between 1992 and 1994.

programme.title: Manchester City vs Crystal Palace- English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Man City have lost just one of their last 12 Premier League games against Crystal Palace, going down 2-0 at home in October 2021. Having lost each of their first six Premier League visits to the Etihad Stadium, Crystal Palace have lost just two of their last six away to Man City in the competition.

programme.desc: A month after their epic final in Roland-Garros, Jannik Sinner and Carlos Alcaraz are doing this: the two masters of the ATP circuit meet in the Wimbledon final to write a new page of their rivalry. Winner in Paris after a crazy comeback, Alcaraz aims for a historic hat -trick in London (2023, 2024, 2025). Faced with him, Sinner dreams of a first coronation on lawn, which would allow him to conquer a third different major, at only 23 years old. It will be their 13th duel. The Spaniard leads 8-4, remains on five consecutive victories and has not been beaten by the Italian since October 2023. But their only confrontation on grass, already in Wimbledon, had turned to the advantage of Sinner in 2022. Alcaraz aims for continuity, sinner. Between two wonders already in legend, the final promises a summit up to their meteoric ascent.

programme.desc: CLAP FINDING IN APOTOTHEMENT AT THE EURO ESPERS 2025: Germany defies England in the final in Bratislava for electric revenge between two European football giants. Beaten by the Mannschaft in the group phase (2-1), the Young Lions of Lee Carsley have since raised the cursor. Brilliant against Spain (1-3) in quarters, then solid against the Netherlands (2-1), they arrived launched, carried by a sparkling Harvey Elliott: 3 goals and 1 decisive pass in the matches with direct elimination. But Germany impresses even more. Intouchables in hens (9 points), Antonio Di Salvo's men first snatched their place in half against Italy (3-2 A.P.), before offset France (3-0). With 14 goals scored in 5 games, their attack is formidable, led by Nick Woltemade, top scorer of the tournament (6 goals). Between a revengeful England and a Germany in full control, this final promises intensity, talent and fireworks.

programme.title: Finale Dames. Amanda Anisimova / Iga Swiatek
programme.desc: Make way for the grand finale of Wimbledon between the American Amanda Anisimova and the Polish Iga Swiatek. Surprising Sabalenka in the semi-finals (6-4, 4-6, 6-4), Anisimova, 23, competes his very first Grand Chelem final. Mentally solid, she had to fight against Galfi and Noskova, but knew how to seize her luck in a clear painting. It remains to be seen whether the American explosive will still have the energy to challenge the infernal regularity of Iga Swiatek. The world number 8 has left crumbs to its opponents, notably shipping Bencic in a half (6-2, 6-0). Already a quintuple winner in Grand Slam, the Polish is targeting a first coronation at Wimbledon to complete the loop. In full confidence and strong of his experience, Swiatek advances as a great favorite. Anisimova has dropped the world n ° 1, but it is the n ° 1 of the lawn moment that she finds today.

Mentally solid, she had to fight against Galfi and Noskova, but knew how to seize her luck in a clear painting. It remains to be seen whether the American explosive will still have the energy to challenge the infernal regularity of Iga Swiatek. The world number 8 has left crumbs to its opponents, notably shipping Bencic in a half (6-2, 6-0). Already a quintuple winner in Grand Slam, the Polish is targeting a first coronation at Wimbledon to complete the loop. In full confidence and strong of his experience, Swiatek advances as a great favorite. Anisimova has dropped the world n ° 1, but it is the n ° 1 of the lawn moment that she finds today.

programme.title: Tennis : Wimbledon
programme.desc: A month after their epic final in Roland-Garros, Jannik Sinner and Carlos Alcaraz are doing this: the two masters of the ATP circuit meet in the Wimbledon final to write a new page of their rivalry. Winner in Paris after a crazy comeback, Alcaraz aims for a historic hat -trick in London (2023, 2024, 2025). Faced with him, Sinner dreams of a first coronation on lawn, which would allow him to conquer a third different major, at only 23 years old. It will be their 13th duel. The Spaniard leads 8-4, remains on five consecutive victories and has not been beaten by the Italian since October 2023. But their only confrontation on grass, already in Wimbledon, had turned to the advantage of Sinner in 2022. Alcaraz aims for continuity, sinner. Between two wonders already in legend, the final promises a summit up to their meteoric ascent.

programme.title: Finale Dames. Amanda Anisimova / Iga Swiatek
programme.desc: Make way for the grand finale of Wimbledon between the American Amanda Anisimova and the Polish Iga Swiatek. Surprising Sabalenka in the semi-finals (6-4, 4-6, 6-4), Anisimova, 23, competes his very first Grand Chelem final. Mentally solid, she had to fight against Galfi and Noskova, but knew how to seize her luck in a clear painting. It remains to be seen whether the American explosive will still have the energy to challenge the infernal regularity of Iga Swiatek. The world number 8 has left crumbs to its opponents, notably shipping Bencic in a half (6-2, 6-0). Already a quintuple winner in Grand Slam, the Polish is targeting a first coronation at Wimbledon to complete the loop. In full confidence and strong of his experience, Swiatek advances as a great favorite. Anisimova has dropped the world n ° 1, but it is the n ° 1 of the lawn moment that she finds today.

programme.title: Tours / Poitiers
programme.desc: Last act, last breath: the TVB is about to live an evening with a history on Saturday in Grenon, against Poitiers. Winner at the first leg (3-1), Tours has a golden opportunity to win a 10th title of champion of France, which would propel him at the height of AS Cannes at the top of the hexagonal volleyball. But a derby does not obey any logic. Poitiers, heckled but far from being killed, knows that it would be a victory, four daring sets, to write his own legend. The feat of Nantes last year, who came to impose themselves in the gold set, feeds their hopes. The Alterna will count on Nik Mujanovic, in search of a last shine under the pepper colors before joining the TVB this summer. At the end of the road: Europe and the Champions League. But for Tours, it is also the culmination of a forged season in the fight. From Luca Ramon to Ryan Sclater, all want to write the perfect epilogue under the leadership of Marcelo Fronckowiak and engrave their name in the marble of Grenon.

programme.desc: During the first leg, which was barely a minute before, Harvey Elliott had not let the opportunity to score the only goal of the game at the end of the match (87th). Yet until then, Paris-SG had produced, against Liverpool, one of its best performances of the season. It was now a miracle for Parisians to win in Anfield Road.

programme.title: Atlético Madrid / Real Madrid
programme.desc: In the first leg, Real Madrid took the advantage 2-1 with achievements by Rodrygo and Brahim Diaz. On the Atlético side, Julian Alvarez had found the way to the nets. This 8th final return of the Champions League between the two clubs in the Spanish capital therefore seems quite open, where nothing is played. Will the Atlético Colchoneros overthrow the steam in front of their audience?

programme.title: Canal Foot Manager
programme.desc: A collection centered on tactical decryption in football. Immersive pallets and analyzes, Gauthier Kuntzmann delivers the keys to the methods used by coaches.

programme.title: Lille / Borussia Dortmund
programme.desc: Lille Dogues can feed regrets after their draw won in Dortmund (1-1). Indeed, Bruno Genesio's men could have returned with a victory as they showed great things in Germany, in the second half. In favorable toll, Thomas Meunier and his partners intend to win this time and to continue the adventure in the Champions League.

programme.title: Arsenal / PSV Eindhoven
programme.desc: Thanks to their very wide victory in the first leg, thanks to a double from Martin Ödegaard and, more generally, to an offensive collective festival (1-7), the Gunners of Arsenal took a big step towards the quarter-finals. This round of finals, disputed at the Emirates Stadium in London, should only be a formality for the players of Mikel Arteta.

programme.title: Eintracht Francfort / Ajax Amsterdam
programme.desc: Who will succeed the Atalanta Bergame at the top of the Europa League? Thirty-six European clubs are engaged in the race for the victory of this 2024/2025 edition of the continental competition

programme.title: Manchester United / Real Sociedad
programme.desc: Held in check (1-1) in the first leg, Manchester United welcomed Real Sociedad on his Old Trafford lawn, in the 8th round of the Europa League. A poster to say the least indecisive between two of the favorites for the final victory in the competition, whose winner will be opposed to that of Lyon / Bucharest in the quarterfinals.

programme.title: Athletic Bilbao / AS Roma
programme.desc: Beaten by AS Rome in the first leg (2-1), Athletic Bilbao overturned AS Rome (3-1) in San Mamés, thanks in particular to the exclusion of Mats Hummels after only twelve minutes of play. With a double of Nico Williams, Bilbao qualified for the quarter-finals of the Europa League. The Basques dominated their subject, despite a little fear at the end of the match.

programme.title: History of Champions - Season 3
programme.desc: Back on the most beautiful matches in the history of the Champions League, with the exploits of French clubs, OL of Juninho, the first steps of the young Mbappé with AS Monaco, the OM which overthrows Dortmund or PSG more than ever close to the Graal. But also evenings on the biggest clubs in the competition (Manchester United, Real Madrid, Bayern Munich), on the biggest stars (Lionel Messi, Cristiano Ronaldo, Karim Benzema, Thierry Henry) or even thematic evenings (Rontada, fratricidal duels).
